verdict_text:
YES

The script removes every `h.2.*`, `h.5.*`, `h.8.*` tensor, renumbers survivors in original order (0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10,11 to 0..8) via a collision-free rebuild into a fresh dict, passes non-block tensors through unchanged, and asserts before writing that the surviving block index set is exactly {0..8} (which also rules out blocks 9, 10, 11) and that the output holds exactly 121 tensors. It writes a single `out/T1/model.safetensors` only after the checks pass.
